title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at D-Wave Quantum, Oxford Quantum Circuits, and Bifrost Electronics - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Three quantum executive moves: D-Wave (QBTS) adds ex-BNP Paribas Group CIO Bernard Gavgani to its board and cybersecurity committee; OQC shifts CTO Simon Phillips to CPO to commercialize Quantum-AI data center platforms after a £260M Series C; Bifrost Electronics hires ex-Solid Power co-founder Doug Campbell as CEO to scale its Heimdall amplifier.

insights.claim: D-Wave Quantum (NASDAQ: QBTS) appointed Bernard Gavgani, Senior Advisor for Technology and Innovation to BNP Paribas executive management and former BNP Paribas Group CIO, to its Board of Directors and Cybersecurity Committee.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A tier-one bank technologist on the board signals D-Wave courting financial-services enterprise buyers and hardening governance.

insights.claim: D-Wave is expanding dual-platform quantum offerings for enterprise deployments and is bolstering cybersecurity and AI-governance oversight at board level to support that push.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Watch QBTS enterprise contract announcements, particularly in banking, as a test of the dual-platform strategy.

insights.claim: Oxford Quantum Circuits moved Simon Phillips from CTO to Chief Product Officer to lead commercialization of enterprise-ready Quantum-AI data center platforms.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A CTO-to-CPO shift marks a transition from technology build to product/revenue focus at OQC.

insights.claim: OQC recently closed a £260 million Series C and has joint platform development initiatives with JPMorgan Chase and AMD.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Large private raise plus bank and chipmaker partners make OQC a well-funded private competitor to listed quantum names.

insights.claim: Phillips, at OQC since 2019, led three generations of quantum systems and the expansion of OQC's deployed systems into colocation data centers.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Colocation data-center deployments are OQC's go-to-market channel; relevant to data-center operators positioning for quantum-AI.

insights.claim: Bifrost Electronics named Doug Campbell, who co-founded Colorado battery startup Solid Power and led it through a 2021 IPO, as CEO.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hiring a CEO with an IPO track record suggests Bifrost is preparing for scale-up and possibly a later capital-markets path.
insights.locator: Bifrost Electronics has named deep-tech entrepreneur

insights.claim: Bifrost's Heimdall Amplifier is a magnetically insensitive quantum readout amplifier that eliminates Josephson junctions, aimed at resolving readout scaling bottlenecks for superconducting and spin-based quantum hardware.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Readout electronics are a picks-and-shovels bottleneck; component suppliers can benefit regardless of which qubit modality wins.
insights.locator: Bifrost Electronics has named deep-tech entrepreneur
